mechanism: Piperacillin-tazobactam may cause diarrhea, and concurrent use of loperamide (antidiarrheal) could mask symptoms of antibiotic-associated diarrhea or increase risk of toxic megacolon in C. difficile infection.
action: Avoid loperamide during piperacillin-tazobactam therapy; if diarrhea develops, evaluate for C. difficile infection before considering antidiarrheal agents.
